description: Reads alt text on a page. Pass a public `url` or `html`. Counts every img element (not a sample) and states how many it read and how many it skipped as aria-hidden or presentational. Flags missing alt, file names and camera names (IMG_1234, Name_With_Underscores.jpg), alt equal to the file stem, placeholder words, "image of" openers, fallback patterns such as "Title, picture", duplicate alt text across different images, alts over 150 characters, and empty alt inside a link that has no other text. Also checks og:image:alt and twitter:image:alt (missing, empty, or poor). Tells you if the page was cut off. Reads delivered markup only: script-added images, CSS backgrounds and inline SVG are not seen, and it cannot judge whether a clean description is accurate.

html.description: HTML source to check instead of a URL.

url.description: A public page URL to fetch.
